Title: Lettres de la Révérende Mère Marie Angélique Arnauld, abbesse et réformatrice de Port-Royal; tome premier
Creator: Marie-Angélique Arnauld (Mère Angélique de Sainte-Madeleine), abbess of Port-Royal; collected after her death, edited anonymously
Publisher: A Utrecht, aux dépens de la Compagnie
Publication Date: 1742
Rights: Public Domain (published 1742, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT')
Language: fra
Source: Internet Archive item lettresdelareve00arnagoog (https://archive.org/details/lettresdelareve00arnagoog), the item's own lettresdelareve00arnagoog_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Oxford University; host metadata date: 1742. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: d2478d922309767cb939a6c134fc2cb12fd263ce6ff730870e8b9fb6c6390ca9.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the host's front matter up to and including the line beginning 'des  recherches  en  ligne' removed (108 lines); nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. Oxford University (Taylor Institution) copy scanned by Google and contributed to the Internet Archive; good OCR of old spelling, long s as f. The Google notice at the head (English and French) is removed by the strip marker.
Content note: The first of the three published volumes of Mère Angélique's letters, with the editors' Avertissement (dated 7 February 1742) on how the collection was gathered at Le Maître's and the Marquise d'Aumont's urging. The letters run in date order from the 1620s, many of the early ones to her brother Arnauld d'Andilly, through the Maubuisson years: spiritual direction of her family and directees, and the business of the reform.
